Roman copper alloy nummus, 19mm in diameter, 1.5mm thick with a weight of 2.65 grams. The coin is in fair condition with a brown patina and rust coloured concretions. The obverse shows left facing laureate? bust holding staff? Inscription reads CONSTANT[TINUSAVG].
